0.131: Testing tools: a BENCHMARK button in debug mode measures how smoothly the game runs on this computer.
0.130: Play stats now include how smoothly the game runs: frame rate per run, plus the device (graphics chip, browser, OS) — no personal data.
0.129: Smoother combat: the new particle effects draw much faster (batched rendering, smaller repaints, no hitch on a room's first hit), and thin out when a huge OVERKILL would flood the screen.
Fixed: stray pixel specks in the name field are gone for good, and letters like Å and Ö no longer lose their tops.
0.128: New combat particles: hits on flesh splash ink-dark blood that spatters onto the floor; bone, fire and spirit enemies burst into bright sparks with an impact ring (fire burns yellow and leaves floating cinders).
OVERKILL! now bursts particles out of every enemy it wipes.
0.127: Behind the scenes: testing tools update (no gameplay changes).
0.126: Low on health? Your HP bar now glows red, and Drink Potion pulses while you still have potions left.
0.125: Phones and tablets now see a 'Mobile platforms not supported yet' notice instead of the game — please play on a desktop or laptop.
0.124: Space now moves you forward on every screen — Enter the Castle, Descend, Push Deeper, Accept Your Fate, Return to the Great Hall — with a small [space] under the button it presses.
0.123: Play stats: the Depth per run chart marks every run that won the game (beat the room 24 boss) with a gold star.
0.122: Play stats: the name a player typed in the game now always shows on the stats page (it overrides renames there), and a name change is sent right away.
0.121: Beat the boss of room 24 and the castle celebrates: a one-time Victory dialog — you've won the game, for now. Start a New Game on the main menu to play it again.
0.120: Stats page: Refresh shows that it worked (time of the update, new runs)
0.119: Under the hood: the play-stats collector stores only what the stats page shows and turns away spam
0.118: The old music is retired: the dark ambient score is the soundtrack (the Score switch is gone)
"Playing as …" is centred on the title screen
Under the hood: one sound registry and real tests for the audio engine
0.117: Fixed: in 0.116 a critical hit could freeze the fight (its sound effect errored)
Under the hood: the combat engine and scene switching are reorganised for easier changes (no gameplay change)
